item.title: Walz appoints Susan DeVos to 5th District bench
item.description: Susan DeVos has been appointed by Gov. Tim Walz as a district court judge in Minnesota’s 5th Judicial District, serving Blue Earth County and surrounding areas.

item.title: Breaking the Ice: From file clerk to Henson Efron president
item.description: Rochelle Hauser has worked her way up from file clerk to president of Minneapolis-based Henson Efron.

item.title: DOJ moves to fire judge-appointed U.S. attorney in northern New York
item.description: The DOJ moved to fire Donald Kinsella, appointed by judges as U.S. attorney for northern New York, asserting only the president can appoint U.S. attorneys.

item.description: These opinions were released by the 8th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals.

item.title: Lawmakers learned through press that Trump wanted to indict them
item.description: Lawmakers discovered through press reports that the Trump administration unsuccessfully sought to indict and arrest them over a military orders video.

item.title: Judge rejects Madison’s stance on uncounted absentee ballots
item.description: A Wisconsin judge rejected Madison's claim that absentee voting is a privilege, affirming it as a constitutional right in a 2024 election ballot lawsuit.

item.title: Judge blocks Pentagon from punishing Sen. Mark Kelly over video
item.description: A federal judge ruled that the Pentagon cannot reduce Senator Mark Kelly's retired rank or pension for urging troops to reject unlawful orders, citing First Amendment protections.

item.title: U of M expulsion over alleged AI cheating upheld on appeal
item.description: Minnesota Court of Appeals upheld the University of Minnesota’s expulsion of a doctoral student accused of using AI to cheat on an exam.

item.title: ACLU sues over missile strike killing Trinidadian men
item.description: The ACLU filed a federal lawsuit seeking accountability for a U.S. missile strike that killed two Trinidadian men in international waters.
